name: deck-config
body: Deck config from kalide.yaml (the legacy name eypres.yaml is not recognised): title (required), author (optional), date (optional, `YYYY-MM-DD`), theme (optional, default `default`), navigation (optional, default|linear|grid, default `default`), properties (optional — arbitrary author-declared deck-wide key/value pairs, each value a typed YAML scalar; see domain.value.deck-properties), and templates (optional — path string naming the deck's external template library directory, relative to the deck root or absolute; see external-template-library). properties and templates are the two additional allowed top-level keys; every other unknown key = error with a closest-match suggestion.
